thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: RATE_LIMITER_429_SPIKE at 2026-03-12T14:20:03Z. Auto-escalation to oncall-sre. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/rl-429-20260312

pagerduty: Trigger: "Rate limiter - unexpected quota enforcement / 429 spike" — Incident ID INC-20260312-9. Detected anomaly: 429 rate > 5x baseline across multiple regions.

maria gonzalez: Acked page 14:20. Im jumping in. Initial triage: check recent config changes and limiter health.

kevin park: Looking at deploy history — theres a config rollout at ~14:15 UTC: rl-config v12 toggled QUOTA_MODE=ENFORCE and set default_quota=120/s. Commit message: "enable default quota enforcement".

ally ng: Observability shows elevated 429s concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings across us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Support queue: several tickets flagged high.

kevin park: Quick diagnostics: pods look healthy but 429s in logs: 
```
WARN 14:20:21 request_id=req_89ab 429 {"error":"rate_limited","customer_id":"acct_7Zx","quota":"default_120/s"}
```
No sign of OOMs or restarts.

maria gonzalez: ops-bot, any deploys at 14:15?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rl-config-v12 rolled to prod at 2026-03-12T14:14:58Z by pipeline. Change: QUOTA_MODE=ENFORCE, default_quota=120/s. No manual approval recorded.

kevin park: Found root of problem: overrides file failed to load during rollout; S3 GET returned 403. So per-customer exceptions didn't land and default enforcement applied to all traffic.

ally ng: Impact: three enterprise customers (acct_7Zx, acct_Ak2, acct_Z1q) are seeing 20-50% failures over last 10m. Severity P1 for SLA-bound accounts. Others have transient spikes.

maria gonzalez: Mitigation plan (immediate): 1) flip QUOTA_MODE back to MONITOR 2) scale limiter replicas to buy headroom 3) reapply overrides with correct S3 ACL 4) notify affected customers and open tickets.

kevin park: Executing rollback steps now. Running:
```
kubectl set env deploy/rate-limiter QUOTA_MODE=MONITOR -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deploy/rate-limiter -n prod
kubectl scale deploy/rate-limiter --replicas=8 -n prod
```

ops-bot: Commands accepted: QUOTA_MODE set to MONITOR; rollout started; scaling to 8 replicas initiated.

maria gonzalez: Monitoring graphs: 429 counts dropping ~75% within 5 minutes. Still seeing retries and backlog causing some residual errors.

ally ng: Ill fix S3 permissions and re-deploy overrides. Granting infra-config-sa s3:GetObject on rl-overrides bucket, then push overrides.json.

kevin park: Applying overrides from S3 after permission fix:
```
aws s3 cp s3://rl-overrides/overrides.json /tmp/overrides.json && kubectl create configmap rl-overrides --from-file=/tmp/overrides.json -n prod --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f - && kubectl rollout restart deploy/rate-limiter -n prod
```

ops-bot: Configmap rl-overrides updated. Rolling restart of rate-limiter started. New pods coming up Ready.

maria gonzalez: Confirmed in-memory overrides present: acct_7Zx=1200/s, acct_Ak2=800/s, acct_Z1q=1000/s. 429 rate for those accounts dropped to baseline.

ally ng: Drafted customer notification and posted to #customers-notify with support ticket IDs SUP-4312 and SUP-4313. Message explains root cause and mitigation.

kevin park: Suggest holding P1 until 15:00 UTC for observation. Recommend post-incident review to tighten release checks.

maria gonzalez: Agreed. Creating incident doc and timeline. Tagging eng-sre, product, and support.

jonathan lee: Ill pick up the 14:30-15:30 handoff. Summary for oncall: root cause = config rollout enabling enforcement while overrides missing due to S3 permission; mitigations = revert QUOTA_MODE, scale pods, reapply overrides; follow-ups = CI preflight for overrides presence, canary/quota rollout, alert on sudden 429 delta.

kevin park: Postmortem action items assigned: 1) CI: fail release if overrides missing (kevin) 2) Add canary/gradual rollout for quota toggles (jonathan) 3) Add per-customer 429 delta dashboard and alert (ally) 4) Tune HPA CPU thresholds for limiter to avoid slow scale (maria).

maria gonzalez: Incident mitigated at 14:28:40Z. PagerDuty status: acknowledged -> resolved (mitigated) at 2026-03-12T14:28:50Z. Monitoring until 15:00.

jonathan lee: Handoff complete. Ill run the post-incident at 16:00 in #eng-sre and collect logs and deploy traces. If anything flares, re-page. :white_check_mark:

maria gonzalez: Handoff note left: deploy hashes, S3 ACL change, metrics snapshots, support ticket links. Closing ops thread; follow-ups tracked in tickets/retro. :thumbsup:

kevin park: One extra note: autoscaling was slow because HPA targets were conservative; include HPA tuning in action items.

ops-bot: Incident INC-20260312-9 closed in PagerDuty by maria gonzalez at 2026-03-12T14:28:50Z.

maria gonzalez: Closing thread. Monitoring window open until 15:00 UTC.
